title: Scripted+gate-on has no golden or replay-gate coverage — the B1 pins close the unit vacuity but the integration tier is absent
evidence:
testing.expect_value(t, fires, 1)
testing.expect(t, fire_tick >= 600, "the gated scripted advance must fire at the window (>= 600), not at the scripted tick 100")
--- demos/era_advance.dem:22 ---
at 25000ms advance 3
--- demos/advance_fire.dem:26 ---
advance gate on
--- grep: demos with both directives ---
(none — era_advance.dem has 0 occurrences of "advance gate on"; the 3 gate demos have no "at <n>ms advance")
detail: fires==1+fire_tick>=600+!replay_error pin the gated scripted fire at unit level, but no .dem combines `advance gate on` with a scripted `advance`; the ODN-17 replay gate, stats-check, and drift flips never exercise the scripted+gated fire, so its exact fire tick is unpinned at the golden tier.
recommended_fix: Add a demo (era 2, `advance gate on`, `at 25000ms advance 3`) blessed T1 + bit-for-bit replay, mirroring advance_fire.dem; the replay gate then pins the gated scripted fire deterministically.

title: overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal now threads advance_gate_on but still omits growth_on — the same residual-site class r2-W1 fixed for the gate
evidence:
cfg := Demo_Replay{
	name = d.name,
	use_fixture = d.use_fixture,
	qos_fixture = d.qos_fixture,
	advance_gate_on = d.advance_gate_on, // 6.2 r2 W2: the B1 flag-threading's residual site — the overlay verb re-sims the gate demos gate-ON too, or its verification frame shows the wrong sim
	session = {goal = d.win_goal, cap_ms = d.lose_cap_ms, health_on = d.health_on, surge_win_pct = d.surge_win_pct},
}
--- harness/run.odin:280-281 (the sibling literal that carries both) ---
growth_on = demo.growth_on, // 5.1: run setup — the director's map growth
advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on, // 6.2: run setup — the era-advance gate (r1 B1: the live/bless path MUST carry the flag or the blessed goldens pin gate-off runs while the replay path — load_demo_replay — runs gate-on and diverges at the fire tick)
detail: overlay-check (manual verb, not CI-gated) re-sims growth demos growth-off — its verification frame shows the wrong sim, precisely the class the r2-W1 comment names. No test pins any Demo_Replay cfg-literal construction.
recommended_fix: Add `growth_on = d.growth_on` to overlay.odin's literal (mirror run.odin:280); longer term, build the cfg in one shared helper and pin its run-setup set in a harness test.
